trackers.title: US Measles Tracker
trackers.description: Independent, sourced tracker of the 2026 US measles surge: CDC case counts, cases by state, outbreaks, deaths, elimination status and a dated timeline.

status.label: Growing · most since 1991
status.summary: CDC counted 3,887 confirmed cases in 47 jurisdictions as of 1 October, up 228 in a week, and 95% are linked to outbreaks. Pennsylvania's outbreak, centred on Lancaster County, has passed 1,000 cases and five deaths by the state's count. A regional health body will decide in November whether the US has lost the measles elimination status it has held since 2000.

trackers.headline: US measles cases reach 3,887, the most since 1991. Pennsylvania passes 1,000 cases and New York declares a disaster emergency.

latest.title: Pennsylvania passes 1,000 cases; New York declares a disaster emergency

trackers.title: Ebola Tracker: DR Congo
trackers.description: Independent, sourced tracker of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: confirmed cases and deaths, affected provinces, spread to other countries, vaccines, WHO risk and a dated timeline.

status.label: Growing · global health emergency
status.summary: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak declared on 15 May has spread to 63 health zones in 7 of DR Congo's 26 provinces. CDC counted 8,442 confirmed cases and 4,080 deaths as of 2 October, the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. There is no licensed vaccine for this strain; trials of an existing Ebola vaccine began in August.

trackers.headline: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak passes 8,400 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths. Kenya reports its first imported case.

latest.title: Kenya's first imported case dies in Nairobi

trackers.title: Russia Plague Watch
trackers.description: Independent, sourced tracker of the suspected plague case in Irkutsk, Siberia: live incubation countdown, case counts, WHO risk level, claim check and a dated timeline.

status.label: Suspected, unconfirmed
status.summary: A 28-year-old worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died overnight on 1–2 October after severe pneumonia. Media reports link the death to pneumonic plague. Russian authorities list the cause as "pneumonia of unknown etiology". On 6 October Russia told WHO that no dangerous pathogens were found in any contact tested.

trackers.headline: Russia tells WHO no plague found in contacts. WHO rates the risk low for Russia, moderate to low for Irkutsk.

latest.title: No plague found in contacts tested so far
